title: Canonical semilinear proper/open compositors and intrinsic clopen comparison
statement:
Let $u$ be a universe, $C_n$ a sequence of commutative rings in universe $u+1$, and $\tau_n:C_{n+1}\to C_n$ arbitrary ring homomorphisms. For schemes in universe $u$, use the strict semilinear module-system categories $\mathscr S_X$, their ordinary unbounded derived categories $\mathcal D_X$, the ordinary inverse/direct image adjunctions, the derived adjunctions $P_f\dashv R_f$, and the exact ordinary open extensions and their localizations $J_j$ of [def-sp-semilinear-constant-ring-operations]. The following specifies their canonical comparison data.

For composable scheme maps $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$, let $\rho_{f,g}:g_{*,\bullet}f_{*,\bullet}\cong(gf)_{*,\bullet}$ be the unique ordinary direct-image isomorphism whose component on every system $M$, level $n$, pro-etale test object $U\to Z$ and section is restriction along the canonical isomorphism between $U\times_ZY\times_YX$ and $U\times_ZX$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Define the ordinary inverse-image compositor $(gf)^*_{\bullet}\cong f^*_{\bullet}g^*_{\bullet}$ as the inverse of its left-adjoint comparison under the specified ordinary adjunctions. Its exact localization is $d^{-1}_{f,g}:P_{gf}\cong P_fP_g$; define $c_{f,g}:R_gR_f\cong R_{gf}$ as its adjunction conjugate under the composite adjunction [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction], using the mate correspondence [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Similarly the unique ordinary direct-image identity comparison is restriction along $U\cong U\times_XX$ at every level; its left-adjoint comparison and exact localization define $p_X:P_{1_X}\cong\mathrm{id}$, and adjunction conjugation defines $s_X:R_{1_X}\cong\mathrm{id}$.

For an open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], define $J_j\dashv P_j$ by exact localization of the specified ordinary open adjunction [def-weil-exact-derived-adjunction]. For composable open immersions $j,k$, define $e_{j,k}:J_kJ_j\cong J_{kj}$ as the left-adjoint comparison to $P_jP_k\cong P_{kj}$ using these open adjunctions. Equality of open-immersion arrows induces equality of the corresponding $J$ functors independently of their proof instances; use the resulting equality-transport isomorphism. Define $J_{1_X}\cong\mathrm{id}$ by the same open-adjoint comparison to $p_X$. For any commutative square with maps $k:V\to W$, $r:V\to S$, $p:W\to T$, $i:S\to T$ and $pk=ir$, define $\theta_Q:P_rP_i\cong P_kP_p$ by the inverse of $d^{-1}_{r,i}$, transport $P_{ir}=P_{pk}$ along $pk=ir$, and $d^{-1}_{k,p}$.

For a commutative open square $g_U:U'\to U$, $j':U'\hookrightarrow X'$, $j:U\hookrightarrow X$, $g:X'\to X$, define the natural transformation $\beta^{-1}:J_{j'}P_{g_U}\to P_gJ_j$ to be the $J_{j'}\dashv P_{j'}$ adjunct of $P_{g_U}\eta^J_j$ followed by the inverse of the preceding pullback-square comparison. For a Cartesian such square this transformation is invertible; define $\beta:P_gJ_j\cong J_{j'}P_{g_U}$ as its inverse isomorphism. The open-adjunction unit $\eta^J_j$ is invertible. Define $\iota_j:J_j\to R_j$ as the $P_j\dashv R_j$ adjunct of $(\eta^J_j)^{-1}:P_jJ_j\to\mathrm{id}$. For $s:U\to X$ both open and closed, $\iota_s$ is invertible; define $\pi_s:\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal D_X}\to J_sP_s$ by $\eta^P_s$ followed by $\iota_s^{-1}P_s$. Thus $\pi_s$ is the identity on the selected clopen component and zero on its complementary open.

Finally, for a commutative square $Q$ as above with $k,i$ quasi-compact open immersions and $r,p$ proper [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], put $W_S=W\times_TS$ with projections $b:W_S\to W$, $q:W_S\to S$, and the induced clopen immersion $s=(k,r):V\to W_S$ [def-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-arrows]. Define the intrinsic comparison
$$\alpha_Q:P_pJ_i\xrightarrow{\beta}J_bP_q\xrightarrow{J_b\pi_sP_q}J_bJ_sP_sP_q\xrightarrow{\sim}J_kP_r,$$
where the last isomorphism uses exactly the specified open and pullback compositors and equality transports $bs=k$, $qs=r$. These are comparisons on the simultaneous unbounded derived system categories, before evaluation or restriction of scalars, with no flatness, finiteness or boundedness hypothesis on coefficients or objects and no Cartesian or separated-structure-morphism hypothesis on $Q$.
